title: Shop
statementMd:
Vasya plays one very well-known and extremely popular MMORPG game. His game character has $*k*$ skill; currently the $*i*$-th of them equals to $*a*_{*i*}$. Also this game has a common rating table in which the participants are ranked according to the **product** of all the skills of a hero in the descending order.

Vasya decided to 'upgrade' his character via the game store. This store offers $*n*$ possible ways to improve the hero's skills; Each of these ways belongs to one of three types:

1. assign the $*i*$-th skill to $*b*$;
2. add $*b*$ to the $*i*$-th skill;
3. multiply the $*i*$-th skill by $*b*$.

Unfortunately, a) every improvement can only be used once; b) the money on Vasya's card is enough only to purchase not more than $*m*$ of the $*n*$ improvements. Help Vasya to reach the highest ranking in the game. To do this tell Vasya which of improvements he has to purchase and in what order he should use them to make his rating become as high as possible. If there are several ways to achieve it, print any of them.

## Input

The first line contains three numbers — $*k*, *n*, *m*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{5}$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of skills, the number of improvements on sale and the number of them Vasya can afford.

The second line contains $*k*$ space-separated numbers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$), the initial values of skills.

Next $*n*$ lines contain $3$ space-separated numbers $*t*_{*j*}, *i*_{*j*}, *b*_{*j*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*j*} ≤ 3, 1 ≤ *i*_{*j*} ≤ *k*, 1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{6}$) — the type of the $*j*$-th improvement (1 for assigning, 2 for adding, 3 for multiplying), the skill to which it can be applied and the value of $*b*$ for this improvement.

## Output

The first line should contain a number $*l*$ ($0 ≤ *l* ≤ *m*$) — the number of improvements you should use.

The second line should contain $*l*$ distinct space-separated numbers $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) — the indices of improvements in the order in which they should be applied. The improvements are numbered starting from $1$, in the order in which they appear in the input.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 正在游玩一款非常知名且极其热门的 MMORPG 游戏。他的游戏角色拥有 $*k*$ 项技能，目前第 $*i*$ 项技能的值为 $*a*_{*i*}$。此外，游戏中还有一个公共排行榜，所有参与者按照角色全部技能值的**乘积**降序排名。

Vasya 决定通过游戏商店来“强化”他的角色。商店提供了 $*n*$ 种可用于提升英雄技能的方式；每种方式属于以下三种类型之一：

1. 将第 $*i*$ 项技能赋值为 $*b*$；
2. 将 $*b*$ 加到第 $*i*$ 项技能上；
3. 将第 $*i*$ 项技能乘以 $*b*$。

遗憾的是：a) 每种强化最多只能使用一次；b) Vasya 卡中的钱最多只能购买 $*n*$ 种强化中的 $*m*$ 种。请帮助 Vasya 在游戏中取得尽可能高的排名。为此，请告诉 Vasya 他需要购买哪些强化，以及应按什么顺序使用它们，使他的排名尽可能高。如果有多种方案都能达到最大值，输出任意一种即可。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 — $*k*, *n*, *m*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{5}$，$0 ≤ *m* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）— 技能数量、商店中出售的强化数量，以及 Vasya 能够购买的强化数量。

第二行包含 $*k*$ 个空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$），表示技能的初始值。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $3$ 个空格分隔的整数 $*t*_{*j*}, *i*_{*j*}, *b*_{*j*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*j*} ≤ 3, 1 ≤ *i*_{*j*} ≤ *k*, 1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{6}$）— 第 $*j*$ 种强化的类型（1 表示赋值，2 表示加法，3 表示乘法）、它所作用的技能，以及该强化中的 $*b*$ 值。

## 输出格式

第一行应包含一个整数 $*l*$（$0 ≤ *l* ≤ *m*$）— 你应使用的强化数量。

第二行应包含 $*l*$ 个互不相同且以空格分隔的整数 $*v*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）— 按使用顺序排列的强化编号。强化从 $1$ 开始编号，编号顺序与它们在输入中出现的顺序相同。
